landing.eyebrow: Rent, bills and receipts for Bangladeshi buildings
landing.title: Every taka of rent, worked out and explained.
landing.lead: BasaManager builds each tenant's bill every month: rent, service, gas, water and metered electricity. Tenants pay online or by cash and bKash, and everyone gets a receipt.
landing.inviteNote: Tenants and caretakers join by an invite from their landlord.
landing.whyLead: No more working out electricity on a calculator. Enter the meter reading and the bill shows the sum, so a tenant can check it in five seconds. Move-ins in the middle of the month are prorated to the day, and a late fee is added once, only on what's unpaid.
landing.point1Desc: Online payments through SSLCommerz are confirmed with the gateway before a bill is marked paid. Cash and bKash claims wait for you or your caretaker to confirm. Every payment gets a numbered PDF receipt.
landing.point2Desc: Tenants report a leak with photos. Your caretaker updates it from his phone and the tenant sees each step as it happens.
landing.step1Desc: Rent, service, gas and water per flat, and how electricity is metered.
landing.step2Desc: They get an email link and see their bills on their phone. No app to install.
landing.step3Desc: On your bill day, with reminders before and after the due date.
landing.footerSandbox: Payments in sandbox mode through SSLCommerz
landing.featuresTitle: What BasaManager does for you every month
landing.f4Desc: Post a notice once and every tenant in the building sees it on their phone.
landing.f5Desc: Lease papers and ID copies stay private and open only for people allowed to see them.
landing.f6Desc: What was billed, collected and is still due, per building and per month.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to put the khata away?
landing.ctaLead: Create a landlord account, add your first building and send this month's bills from BasaManager.
landing.noticeSample: Water supply off on Friday, 10 am to 1 pm, for tank cleaning.
landing.heroFacts: No app to install · SSLCommerz payments · PDF receipts
landing.buildingAria: Example building. Choose a flat to see its bill.
landing.repairNote: Kitchen tap leaking · caretaker on the way
landing.tapHint: Tap any flat to open its bill
landing.featuresLead: The four jobs that used to live in a khata, a calculator and a phone full of bKash screenshots.
landing.repairMsg: The kitchen tap in 3A is leaking. Photos attached.
landing.rolesTitle: Made for everyone who lives and works there
landing.roleLandlordDesc: Run every building, unit and lease from one place, and see what was billed, collected and is still due.
landing.roleCaretakerDesc: Enter meter readings, confirm cash and bKash payments, and update repairs from a phone.
landing.roleTenantDesc: Join by invite, see this month's bill with every sum shown, pay online and keep every receipt.
